name: bigfix-relevance-python-stdio
description: Proof of concept: BigFix Relevance lint diagnostics from bigfix-relevance-lsp, run from a local Python. See tools/vscode-extension/README.md.

bigfixRelevancePython.server.command.markdownDescription: The language server executable. The default needs `bigfix-relevance-analyzer` installed so that `bigfix-relevance-lsp` is on `PATH`. To run a checkout instead, set this to `uv` and the arguments to `["run", "--project", "/path/to/bigfix-relevance-analyzer", "bigfix-relevance-lsp"]`.

bigfixRelevancePython.server.args.description: Arguments passed to the server command.

bigfixRelevancePython.maxDocumentBytes.description: Documents larger than this (UTF-8 bytes) are not linted; they get one informational diagnostic instead.

bigfixRelevancePython.trace.server.description: Log the LSP messages between VS Code and the server to the extension's output channel.
